title: fix(formula): an advisory validation rule's date verdict says the rule is skipped and the write proceeds

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg6xDm8LQaqEyuhcYBN6LvNk)_
domain:server#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CYVV6fcAQrNTDQRvPb

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：advisory 校验规则（`severity: 'warning'` / `'info'`）里对日期做加减时，报错不再说「字段静默得到 null」，改说「规则被跳过、写入照常进行、只留一行日志」，配新码 `date-arithmetic-fail-open` / `date-text-arithmetic-fail-open`，文案与同位置的类型不匹配判词一字不差。
- **为什么改**：advisory 规则出错时运行时跳过该规则并放行写入，那里没有字段，也没有东西读到 null，旧句说的是不会发生的事。
- **风险与回滚**：分级不变（仍是 error），发布门不收也不放，只换文案和码。按旧码 `date-arithmetic` / `date-text-arithmetic` 识别 advisory 规则的使用方需改认新码。公式字段原码原句不动。回滚即 revert，无数据迁移。
- **先看**：`packages/formula/src/validate.ts` 的 `dateArm` 与 `dateArmFault`（`fail-open` 分支），`packages/formula/src/expression-refusal.ts` 的两个新码。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-expressions.test.ts -t 30494`，预期 1 条通过：warning / info 规则的日期判词说规则被跳过、写入照常，不含 null；公式字段对照仍说 null。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

Fixes #30494

Clause-②: yes (widening) — two codes join `@objectstack/formula`'s exported `ExpressionRefusalCode` / `EXPRESSION_REFUSAL_CODES`: `date-arithmetic-fail-open` and `date-text-arithmetic-fail-open`, each with the params of the code it splits from. An advisory rule's date verdicts move to them from `date-arithmetic` / `date-text-arithmetic` (a consumer keyed to the old codes on an advisory rule re-keys). The grade is unchanged; what is refused, warned or passed is unchanged.
Metadata-protocol: none — what an author can write is unchanged, and `os validate` reports no expression refusal code: its findings are `@objectstack/lint`'s `ExprIssue` (`where`, `message`, `source`, `severity`, `path`), re-measured at `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts:157`, which carries no `code`. Only the message text changes there.
Skills-docs: none — `git grep -c "silently evaluates to null" -- skills` answers no hit (exit 1); control: `git grep -c "evaluates to" -- skills` hits `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`, `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` and `skills/objectstack-data/rules/validation.md`, none of them about a date verdict on an advisory rule.

## What changes

Measured on `main` with PR #30492 merged (`67d5d5375`), and again after `origin/main` was merged at `a4c3e738`.

| site | before | now |
|:--|:--|:--|
| advisory (`warning` / `info`) validation rule (`faultOutcome: 'fail-open'`): date arithmetic | `date-arithmetic` / `date-text-arithmetic`, error, "this faults at runtime, so the field silently evaluates to null." | `date-arithmetic-fail-open` / `date-text-arithmetic-fail-open`, error: "this faults at runtime, and here the rule is advisory, so a rule that cannot be evaluated is skipped, not refused: the write proceeds, the rule is never applied (its advisory never fires), and the only trace is a log line saying it could not be evaluated." |
| formula field, display predicate (no outcome) | `date-arithmetic` / `date-text-arithmetic` | unchanged, code and sentence |
| fail-closed site, flow condition | the `-fail-closed` / `-run-fails` / `-run-may-fail` codes | unchanged |

- **One outcome, one sentence.** `dateArmFault` closes the `fail-open` arm on `TYPE_MISMATCH_FAULT_ARMS['fail-open'].clause` itself, not a copy, so the date verdict and the type-mismatch verdict on the same rule cannot drift apart.
- **One code per template**, as #30250 did for fail-closed: `expression-refusal.ts` is the contract that a code names one message template.
- **No new signal.** `@objectstack/lint`'s `faultOutcomeOf` ledger already answers `fail-open` for a `warning` / `info` rule (`validate-expressions.ts:1358`), and MCP `validate_expression` already passes it for `site: 'validation'` with `severity: 'warning' | 'info'` (`mcp-http-tools.ts:666`). Neither package changes.

## Tests

- `packages/formula/src/validate.test.ts`:
  - new: on a `fail-open` `record` site, `record.start_date + 1 > 3` and `record.end_date - record.start_date > duration("24h")` get the `-fail-open` codes and the fail-open sentence, and not "evaluates to null". Control: the same two predicates with no outcome keep `date-arithmetic` / `date-text-arithmetic` and the null sentence;
  - changed: the #30250 test's third control asserted that an advisory rule keeps `date-arithmetic` and the null sentence, which is this card's defect. That row is dropped; its formula-field controls stay.
- `packages/formula/src/expression-refusal-codes.test.ts`: a `PINS` entry for each new code (exact params and message), and `SWEEP_SCHEMAS` gains the `fail-open` date schema, so the sweep reaches both codes and holds their params to their messages.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.test.ts`, new: a `warning` rule and an `info` rule with date arithmetic say the rule is skipped and the write proceeds (not null, not refused). Control: a formula field's `record.close_date + 1` keeps the null sentence.
- `packages/mcp/src/mcp-validate-expression.test.ts`: unchanged, verbatim. Measured once with a probe file that was deleted afterwards (not committed): `validate_expression` at `site: 'validation'` answers `date-arithmetic-fail-open` / `date-text-arithmetic-fail-open` for `severity: 'warning'` and `'info'`, `-fail-closed` for `'error'`, and `date-arithmetic` at `site: 'formula'`; each message equals `validateStackExpressions`' on the same rule.

## Acceptance notes

- **`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts:1338-1341` doc comment** names the date verdicts' `-run-fails`, `-run-may-fail` and `-fail-closed` arms and not the new `-fail-open` one. It says nothing false (it never says an advisory rule keeps the null sentence), and `packages/lint/src/**` source is outside this card's file surface, so it is left as is.
- **The #30250 changeset** (`.changeset/30250-fail-closed-date-and-sweep-run-fails-sentences.md`) says an advisory rule keeps `date-arithmetic` / `date-text-arithmetic`. Both changesets ship in the same release; this PR's changeset says it replaces that note, and the other file is not edited here.
- **`content/docs/data-modeling/formulas.mdx` date-arithmetic row** says "this always faulted to `null`". That describes a formula's runtime, and this PR changes no runtime, so it is left as is (as #30250 left it).
- **Merge.** `origin/main` was merged once at `a4c3e738`. The branch had carried PR #30492's head as a merge until it landed as a squash, so git reported conflicts in the five files both sides touch. They were resolved by applying this branch's own diff (`ebda9aca..34b93ec4`) to `origin/main`'s copies: it applied cleanly, and the changed lines of the resolved delta are identical to that diff's.

## Verification
